title: A Unified Analytical Nullspace-Based Least-Squares Design of the Farrow Structure
summary: Farrow structures based on linear--phase FIR subfilters provide an efficient realization of variable fractional--delay (VFD) filters with reduced implementation complexity. While the all--linear--phase configuration admits a decoupled least--squares (LS) formulation with an analytical solution, this decoupling fails when branches of mixed types, linear--phase and general FIR, are required, as occurs when a group--delay constraint is imposed.
